request.prompt: One freestanding small cottage garden candle lantern. Dark desaturated charcoal bronze square frame, four slim corner posts, pitched cap roof and round carrying loop. A thick cream pillar candle visible inside through open sides, warm amber candle tip. Opaque frame and candle, no glass panels. Soft bevels, restrained worn finish. Standalone stylized 3D prop for Paws, a cosy miniature cat garden. Softly sculpted rounded silhouettes, warm cream/sage/muted terracotta palette, matte non-plastic materials, broad restrained detail, neutral diffuse lighting, no cast shadows painted into textures, no background scene, no cats. Match docs/design/paws-style-reference.png art direction.
